spans.s: मम Ind. The genitive singular of the first personal pronoun.

ममता f. (-ता)
 1. Pride, arrogance, self-sufficiency.
 2. The interest or
affection entertained for other objects from considering them as
belonging to or connected with one's self.
 3. Individuality.
 E. मम
mine, the possessive case of अस्मद्, and तल् aff. of the abstract;
also with त्व aff. ममत्व ।

ममतायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Selfish.
 m. (-क्तः) A miser, a niggard.
 E. ममता
selfishness, and युक्त affected.

. Selfish.
 m. (-कः)
 1. A miser, a
niggard.
 2. A mother's brother.
 E. ममक mine, from मम the poss.
case of अहम् I, and अण् added.

मामकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mine.
 E. मम mine, खञ् aff.
